tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search products in Demo Store. Returns matching products with prices, images, availability, and direct links. Results include data for generating a visual product carousel artifact with category filtering.

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific product in Demo Store, including all variants, sizes, colors, and availability.

tools.name: browse_categories
tools.description: List all product categories in Demo Store with product counts.

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description:
Create a shopping cart in Demo Store. Returns a cart_id for use with get_shipping_rates, preview_checkout, and complete_checkout.

tools.name: get_shipping_rates
tools.description:
Get available shipping rates for the cart. Collects shipping address via elicitation if supported.

SKYFIRE TOKEN (optional): Pass a kya or kya-pay token in the skyfire-pay-id header to boost trust score. No token required — request proceeds normally if omitted.

tools.name: select_shipping_option
tools.description:
Select a shipping method for the cart. Must call get_shipping_rates first.

SKYFIRE TOKEN (optional): Pass a kya or kya-pay token in the skyfire-pay-id header to boost trust score. No token required — request proceeds normally if omitted.

tools.name: apply_discount
tools.description:
Apply a discount or promo code to the cart.

SKYFIRE TOKEN (optional): Pass a kya or kya-pay token in the skyfire-pay-id header to boost trust score. No token required — request proceeds normally if omitted.

tools.name: preview_checkout
tools.description:
Preview the complete order summary before payment. Advances the session to ready-for-payment state.

SKYFIRE TOKEN (optional): Pass a kya or kya-pay token in the skyfire-pay-id header to boost trust score. No token required — request proceeds normally if omitted.

tools.name: ucp_create_checkout
tools.description: Create a UCP checkout session from line items. Returns a UCP checkout object with status 'incomplete'.

tools.name: ucp_get_checkout
tools.description: Retrieve a UCP checkout session by ID. Returns the current state of the checkout.

tools.name: ucp_update_checkout
tools.description: Update a UCP checkout session by fully replacing all line items. Only allowed when status is 'incomplete'.

tools.name: ucp_cancel_checkout
tools.description: Cancel a UCP checkout session. Transitions to 'canceled' status. Cannot cancel already completed checkouts.

tools.name: get_site_map
tools.description: Returns the complete site map of AgenticMCPStores: all public pages organized by category. Use this to discover what sections are available (docs, blog, integrations, legal, marketing) and find the right path before calling get_page_content.

tools.name: get_page_content
tools.description: Read the content of a specific page on AgenticMCPStores. Pass the page slug (e.g. 'for-agents', 'pricing', 'blog') or a blog post slug. Use get_site_map first to discover available slugs. Pass page='blog' to list all blog posts.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Full-text search across all AgenticMCPStores public documentation: pages, blog posts, and FAQ entries. Returns ranked results by relevance. Use this to find answers about protocols, pricing, integration guides, trust scores, and more.

tools.name: search_products_enriched
tools.description: Search products with enriched data including structured attributes, variants, GTIN, and images. Ideal for comparison and detailed product discovery. tools.description: Compare 2 to 5 products side-by-side with normalized attribute table and best-value recommendation.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_site_map" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Returns the complete site map of AgenticMCPStores: all public pages organized by category. Use this to discover what sections are available (docs, blog, integra…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_page_content, search_docs, search_products_enriched · Private data: create_cart, get_shipping_rates, select_shipping_option, apply_discount, preview_checkout, complete_checkout · Public sink: get_page_content.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_page_content, search_docs, search_products_enriched · Private data: create_cart, get_shipping_rates, select_shipping_option, apply_discount, preview_checkout, complete_checkout · Public sink: get_page_content

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
